PART I

INTRODUCTION

“No widget” provisions void

1 A provision in a tenancy agreement prohibiting widgets is void. 2006, c. 17, s. 1; 2017, c. 13, s. 1.

Section Amendments with date in force (d/m/y)

2017, c. 13, s. 1 - 30/05/2017

Gadget deposits

2.1 (1) A landlord may require a gadget deposit if, 2006, c. 17, s. 2.1 (1).

(a) the tenant agrees in writing; and

(b) the deposit is returned at the end of the tenancy.

Same, repealed

(1.1) Repealed: 2020, c. 16, s. 2.

Same, amount

(2) The deposit shall not exceed one month’s rent. 2006, c. 17, s. 2.1 (2); 2020, c. 16, s. 3; 2023, c. 10, s. 4.

Note: On a day to be named by proclamation of the Lieutenant Governor, section 2.1 of the Act is amended by adding the following subsection:

Same, interest

(3) Interest on the deposit is payable yearly.

Old gadget rule

3 Repealed: 2020, c. 16, s. 5.

Note: On a day to be named by proclamation of the Lieutenant Governor, the Act is amended by adding the following section:

Gizmo rules

3.1 (1) This section applies to gizmos.

(2) Gizmos are not widgets.
